name: Jia Yao Holdings Limited
summary: Jia Yao Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the design, production, and sale of electronic cigarettes and other electronic cigarette products in China and Hong Kong. The company also offers tobacco-related products. In addition, it provides transportation and custom clearance services for electronic cigarette-related products. The company exports its products. It serves customers in the Americas, Europe, and Asia. The company was formerly known as Tourism International Holdings Limited and changed its name to Jia Yao Holdings Limited in July 2019. Jia Yao Holdings Limited was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
